newsitem.title: GERMANY: Volkswagen shares climb on delivery figures.
newsitem.headline: Volkswagen shares climb on delivery figures.

text.p: Shares in German carmaker Volkswagen AG traded higher in bourse floor trade on Wednesday after saying its first-half west European car deliveries rose 11.3 percent to 1.451 million vehicles.
Volkswagen shares were up 12.50 marks, or 2.33 percent, to 549.50 marks in bourse trade, while the overall DAX index was up 7.46 points, or 0.29 percent, at 2,566.30 points.
Traders said the delivery figures, combined with Volkswagen forecasts that third quarter group net profit would double in the third quarter, were positively viewed by the market.
